canon.note: Yao Guang is an Elation-path Physical character (Energy limit 180). Basic 150201 Whistlebolt Sings Joy is a Physical Blast (+30 Energy). Skill 150202 Decalight Unveils All spends 1 SP, +30 Energy, deploys the Decalight Zone (shares Yao Guang's Elation with allies) and +3 Punchline. Ultimate 150203 Let All That Is Good Be Brewed spends all Energy, grants the Hexagram of Feathered Fortune All-Type RES PEN buff to allies, gives Aha an extra turn, then uses the Elation Skill (Woe's Whisper vulnAll debuff + Let Thy Fortune Elation hits) and grants Certified Banger. A0 Amaze-In Grace (SPD>=120) adds Elation.

requirements.claim: Talent 'Great Boon': while Certified Banger is held, ally attacks deal extra Elation DMG (elation.ts:320-337, hit label 'Great Boon'). The slow-battle fixture (SPD 101) never builds the Ultimate/CB rotation (2 cycles), so this is pinned to the SPD-200 fixture.
Basic ATK 150201 Whistlebolt Sings Joy is a Physical Blast - main target hit.
Whistlebolt Sings Joy also strikes the adjacent target.
Decalight Unveils All (150202) is Yao Guang's Skill action.
Let All That Is Good Be Brewed (150203) is Yao Guang's Ultimate action.
The Ultimate's Elation Skill deals Let Thy Fortune Burst Physical Elation DMG to every enemy.
Skill 150202 deploys the Decalight Zone (yg_zone) on Yao Guang.
A1 Poised and Sated grants Yao Guang CRIT DMG +60% (yg_a1).
A0 Amaze-In Grace is active at SPD >= 120 (yg_a0).
A0 Amaze-In Grace does NOT apply below SPD 120 (yg_a0 absent).
Ultimate 150203 grants the Hexagram of Feathered Fortune All-Type RES PEN buff (yg_rpen) to allies.
The Elation Skill applies Woe's Whisper (yg_woe, vulnAll) to every enemy.
Yao Guang's Skill (Decalight Zone) resolves before any offensive hit.
Yao Guang's Ultimate gate is the 180-Energy ladder; she never exceeds it.
